newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Aircraft grazes another at Manila airport.
newsitem.headline: Aircraft grazes another at Manila airport.

text.p: A Philippine Airlines plane pulling out of its parking slot for takeoff grazed the next aircraft's tail, delaying both flights for a couple of hours, officials said on Wednesday.

The left wing of the Philippine Airlines Airbus 340, carrying 280 passengers and crew to London, hit the tail of a Boeing 737 belonging to the same airline, a spokesman of the fire and rescue centre at Manila Airport told reporters.
The Boeing 737, carrying 160 passengers and crew, was preparing to takeoff for Butuan in the southern Philippines.

Air Transportation officials said the pilots of the two planes were not aware they had grazed each other until the pilot of another departing plane informed the control tower of the Boeing 737's damaged tail.
This is the latest in a series of mishaps in Philippine airports.
Last week, a light plane landing at an airport in the central Philippines ran over a dog and caught fire. Its three occupants emerged unhurt.
